reference.citation: Moser, Kim & Mansour (1999), Physics of Fluids 11(4), 943-945, DOI 10.1063/1.869966
reference.data_policy: Download original text files; record exact filenames, retrieval timestamp and SHA-256. Never digitize plots or silently substitute the old AGARD CD data.
reference.data_change_note: The UT Austin history records a 2000 correction to z cross-correlations; do not use the superseded chan*.zccorr files from before that correction. The chan180.means numerical header states Re_tau=178.12; do not substitute the rounded 178.13 from secondary tables.

physics.geometry: Plane channel of half-height h; walls y=±h; periodic streamwise x and spanwise z; no-slip walls.
physics.forcing: Pressure-gradient driven, statistically stationary channel flow; the streamwise pressure gradient is varied in time to maintain constant mass flux.
physics.re_tau_definition: Read actual profile Re_tau from original MKM .means headers (178.12, 392.24, 587.19). Nominal labels are not measured values.
physics.re_tau_180_caveat: The Re_tau=180 database has pronounced low-Reynolds-number effects and a very short/absent logarithmic region. Do not enforce a universal log-law fit at this Reynolds number.

identities: Total shear stress must be linear in wall-normal coordinate for fully developed plane channel flow.
At the wall, total stress equals wall shear stress; at the centreline, total shear stress tends to zero.
Mass flux is constant in x and matches the imposed bulk flow.
qoi.normalization: Use the DNS u_tau, h and nu for reference normalization; additionally report CFDX-normalized values to diagnose friction-velocity bias.

model_scope.RANS_SST: Compare mean velocity, wall friction and modelled shear stress. Linear eddy-viscosity Boussinesq closure cannot independently reproduce all DNS Reynolds-stress anisotropy components.
model_scope.RSM: Required if all six Reynolds-stress components are claimed as model validation targets.
model_scope.LES_DNS: Required for spectra, two-point correlations and resolved temporal fluctuations. A steady RANS run cannot pass these gates.

verification.mesh: At least three systematically refined meshes. Report Δx+, Δy+ (including first off-wall point), Δz+ and cell count. Separate RANS wall-function and wall-resolved mesh families.
verification.statistics: Discard transient; demonstrate stationarity and convergence of means and second moments by comparing independent averaging blocks.
verification.conservation: Mass-flow control and pressure-gradient / integrated-wall-shear balance.

status.reason: The current production path audit states that SST/SA/k-epsilon transport is not yet coupled to the production momentum solve.
